summary: No shot fails the name rule: every readable tag is MochiStar, a CPU rival ('Marina · CPU') or a listed placeholder (Luna, Kiko, Bao, Juno, Riku, Pan). Three stills are rejected on other grounds: rankings.png (empty), quests.png (cluttered, glitched text) and wardrobe-hats.png (mid-load). All six beats can be cut from what is here, with PLAY strongest through Open Stage, Coast Rush and Hoops, and Noodle Run, Star Swarm, Brick Bash, Hop Hop and Fishing usable only as tight sub-second crops. The real gaps are that the class swap clip never shows Archer and passes through hybrid looks, and the hook emote has little motion and no wind-up; both can be reshot as a guest. PROGRESS has one usable real clip (levelup.mp4) and otherwise depends on the editor's drawn XP bar and rankings board.
